name: Lucena del Puerto (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, green, white, green and red, the central white stripe of one third and the others of one sixth, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lucena del Puerto (quartered, a bird, a tree and castles).
history: The flag of Lucena del Puerto consists of five horizontal stripes of red, green, white, green and red, the central one of 1/3 and the others of 1/6 of the width of the cloth.

features.role: Lucena del Puerto arms — quartered, bird, tree and castles
castles and crown of the arms
